# SSH declaration fixture

This source overlay extends the invented five-seat Logs fixture with Identity and SSH. It selects ten declaration bodies and changes no accepted fixture. It contains paths and declaration text only, with no key file or key material. This r2 surface candidate is unmeasured; no invocation is claimed by the preparation recipe.

```sh
bash tests/fixtures/ssh-workplace/prepare.sh /absolute/new/config
```

The destination must be new and its parent must exist. Preparation delegates to logs-workplace/prepare.sh, copies the Identity and SSH bodies, and overlays these programs and the selected-layer manifest. It calls no reader, frame, model, agent or key tool and copies no PLAN, BUILD, supplied runtime values or key files. This recipe is source preparation, not evidence of successful formation or execution.

The root SSH program uses an ASCII baseline name and four exact text-capture witnesses: İşlem-α, 鍵[#]%+@=, n:=x and café. The final name is decomposed: its final two code points are U+0065 followed by U+0301. Preserve it as written. The paths contain brackets and hash characters under sealed/keys, below the inherited hidden sealed subtree. Those files do not exist in the fixture and must not be replaced with a user's keys.

The source puts PATH or STATE before NAME, leaving NAME in the final text position:

```text
ssh-key : sealed/keys/[edge]#one.pem = İşlem-α
ssh-grant : granted = İşlem-α
```

Only the surface order changes. The declaration layer must still emit the original ssh-key and ssh-grant argument order, preserving every NAME code point and source origin. That remains an unmeasured obligation of this candidate.

The source repeats one identical key declaration and one identical grant. It places grants at workplace, office, room and seat scopes, and includes explicit none grants. Identity is held at workplace scope and none at Watch's seat. Direct seat grants are authored only at the other seats. These are source cases for separate folding and eligibility checks, not an expected grant table.

The first stop checks declaration formation, emitted values and their origins with independent predictions prepared outside this directory before invocation. It must establish exact NAME preservation rather than infer Unicode or punctuation support from the appearance of a broad text slot. No expected answers, native receipt, frame result or prediction seal is stored here.

Later plan comparison owns private-path hiding, scope selection and Identity-based eligibility. Build and agent checks require keys generated for that test by its authorized operator, outside real homes and views. This fixture provides none. Loading, signing, passphrase behavior, public metadata and private-file isolation are not proved by accepting these declarations.
